أثنوني (form XII)
# أَثْنَوْنِي (ʔaṯnawnī) /ʔaθ.naw.niː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
# أَثْنَوْنِيَ (ʔaṯnawniya) /ʔaθ.naw.ni.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِثْنَوْنَى (iṯnawnā)
